_comment: Copy this file to calendars.json and replace the placeholder URLs.
calendars.json is git-ignored because the secret iCal addresses are
bearer credentials: anyone with the URL can read the whole calendar.
Google: Calendar settings -> 'Secret address in iCal format'
iCloud: Calendar -> Share Calendar -> Public Calendar -> copy the webcal:// link
A source `url` may also point at a public HTML calendar page; the collector
then discovers rel="alternate" type="text/calendar" and webcal/.ics links.
`${VAR}` references are read from the environment so CI can inject secrets.
_llmComment: Optional LLM refinement after de-duplication. It collapses near-duplicate
entries (e.g. "Collin's Birthday" vs "Collin's BDay") and removes times
from all-day occasions. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY (see data-collect/.env).
Set "llmModel" to override the default qwen/qwen3-32b, or run the script
with --no-llm to skip the pass entirely.
